copy.tagline: 弄懂去中心化交易所的池子交易规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在去中心化交易所参与做市或交易,想弄清楚池子原理。
copy.tagline_en: Understand how liquidity pools and swaps work on decentralized exchanges.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're providing liquidity or trading on a DEX and want to understand pool mechanics.

howto.what: Claude 会讲解 Aerodrome 资金池机制:池子类似 Uniswap V2 的 AMM 恒定乘积实现,分稳定型和波动型;涵盖添加/移除流动性、代币兑换、手续费收取与领取、TWAP 价格预言机。
howto.when: 当用户提到「pool」「AMM」「swap」等关键词,或想了解 Aerodrome 资金池运作原理时触发。

say.text: 解释一下 Aerodrome 的稳定池和波动池有什么不同?
say.note: Claude 会对比两种池型的定价公式和适用场景。

say.text: 在 Aerodrome 池子里怎么添加流动性?
say.note: Claude 会说明 mint 流程和首次存入的等值要求。

say.text: Aerodrome 的兑换手续费怎么收、怎么领?

howto.what_en: Claude explains Aerodrome pool mechanics: pools are AMM constant-product implementations similar to Uniswap V2, supporting stable and volatile types; covering adding/removing liquidity, swaps, fee accrual/claims, and TWAP price oracle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'pool', 'AMM', 'swap', or asks about how Aerodrome pools work.

say_en.text: What's the difference between Aerodrome's stable and volatile pools?
say_en.note: Claude compares pricing formulas and use cases.

say_en.text: How do I add liquidity to an Aerodrome pool?
say_en.note: Claude explains the mint flow and equal-value initial deposit requirement.

say_en.text: How are swap fees charged and claimed on Aerodrome?
say_en.note: Claude describes fee storage in PoolFees and claiming steps.
